purpose: Freeze the Theory Universe v0.5 semantic core before empirical-system projection work begins. Prose READMEs and portfolio-registry artifacts may continue to change without revising the core theory version.
versioning_rule: Any change to constitutional axioms A0-A12, canonical type identities, theorem-module statements/claim ceilings, theorem dependency direction, or TU-1 through TU-4 finite result semantics requires a theory version increment beyond v0.5.
frozen_scientific_sentence: Ecological reality is represented by temporally extended model worlds. Scientific states are contract-relative quotients that erase only distinctions irrelevant to a declared future, history, mechanism, evidence, and target responsibility. Evidence determines which required distinctions are identified and what may be reported; causal uncertainty remains set-valued when evidence does not discriminate it. Compression may become unrevisable when later contracts require forgotten distinctions. Learning about causes and licensing a target are distinct utilities. Raw simulator detail is not state complexity: target-relevant states are invariant only under response-faithful representation changes. Warning must be evaluated on a joint warning/loss state, and within-state reproducibility does not imply cross-state portability.
explicitly_open_after_freeze: carrier-changing revision and lift-invariant revision cost
empirical identification of warning-evaluation state and defensible cross-domain portability
empirical_projection_policy: Empirical work may instantiate or falsify the v0.5 core but must not silently redefine its types. A conflict discovered during empirical projection is either a failed projection, a missing bridge, or a versioned theory revision.
